reviews.text: This is the best gym in the area. If you are thinking of joining or passing through, do not hesitate. Eric and the team are great teachers and have fostered a great community for all levels. Come get in shape, make some friends, and learn how to defend yourself.

Dropped in for a BJJ class from out of town and was welcomed into the group immediately. Steven is a great instructor and I would highly recommend. A very convenient location in downtown Boston and a great atmosphere if you're looking for a gritty, hard-working gym environment.
Stellar spot. BJJ classes are excellent and the community is great and very welcoming.
